lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, transitioning to smaller, higher-density clusters toward the rostrum.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and diagonal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular blobs to form a complex, maze-like lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear horizontal features running across the upper-third of the visible flank, defined by sharp light-above-shadow-below vertical intensity gradients.
